We are currently PR-ing frequently to get polyhedral theory into mathlib. However, our PRs have not been moving for weeks (or months). A large part of them is in t-convex-geometry. @Artie Khovanov observed

Artie Khovanov said:

I have looked into it and https://leanprover-community.github.io/queueboard/area_stats.html says there are currently no reviewers available for convex geometry. One reviewer registered, zero on rotation. Looks like this is why our PRs have been stuck for so long!

Is there a way review capacities could be shifted?

This is tricky in general (you cannot grow reviewers on trees --- even though that would really really help sometimes)... but perhaps something can be done here. I'll bring it up within the reviewer team!
